name: email-addresses-section
title: Email addresses section
description: The email addresses on an account: which one is primary, which are verified, add another, make one primary or remove it, each step explained in the row.
docs: Controlled: keep emails in state and update it in each callback. Every callback may return a promise; the row shows a busy state and a rejection is shown in words. Throw an Error with a message from onAdd to explain why an address was refused; the other callbacks show a general message. The primary address cannot be removed and the row says why; removing any other address asks inside the row.
